title: TICKET TRIAGE

intro.headline: Send each message to the right queue
intro.body: Same routing engine, different content. A classifier sits in front of a support inbox and picks one queue per message. Click before it drops. 12 messages per round.

insight: You sorted {accuracy}% correctly, touching {avgActivated} of {total} queues per message. Routing is routing: whether the destinations are experts in a transformer or humans on a support team, a cheap classifier up front means only the right specialist does any work.
